# HL Privateer - Skills LLM Quick Start
# https://hlprivateer.xyz/skills/hl-privateer.md

## Public routes
- GET /healthz
- GET /metrics
- GET /v1/public/markets
- GET /v1/public/floor
- GET /v1/public/floor-tape

## What you can infer
- Market price (`yesPrice`) is the market's implied probability.
- `pHat` is the agent's current YES probability estimate when available.
- `edge` is `pHat - yesPrice`.
- Tape roles are AGT, RSK, EXE, and OPS.
